cards.audioText: How do you make weather analysis before departure?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞前你们如何进行天气分析？
cards.referenceText: I would make good pre-flight preparation. Before departure, listen to the ATIS and check the weather forecast to make a weather analysis. Because there are some adverse weather conditions, such as thunderstorms (TS), lightning strikes, icing, wind shear (WS), and so on. They are very dangerous for flight safety. For example, if we encounter icing during flight, it will degrade the aircraft performance. It will block the pitot tube and there will be abnormal airspeed or altitude indication in the cockpit.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们会做好飞行前准备。起飞前，收听自动终端情报服务（ATIS）并查看天气预报来进行天气分析。因为存在一些恶劣天气状况，比如雷暴（TS）、雷击、积冰、风切变（WS）等等。这些对飞行安全极为危险。例如，若飞行中遭遇积冰，会降低飞机性能。积冰会堵塞空速管，驾驶舱里的空速或高度指示会出现异常。要是机翼上积冰，会减少升力、增加阻力。我们应尽力避开积冰。

cards.audioText: Why is weather a major factor concerning flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 为何天气是关乎飞行安全的主要因素？
cards.referenceText: Yes, adverse weather is a threat to flight safety. Because there are some adverse weather conditions, such as thunderstorms (TS), lightning strikes, icing, wind shear (WS), and so on. They are very dangerous for flight safety. For example, if we encounter icing during flight, it will degrade the aircraft performance. It will block the pitot tube and there will be abnormal airspeed or altitude indication in the cockpit. If ice builds up on the wings, it will decrease the lift and increase the drag.
cards.referenceTextZh: 翻译：是的，恶劣天气对飞行安全构成威胁。因为存在如雷暴（TS）、雷击、积冰、风切变（WS）等恶劣天气状况，它们对飞行安全极为危险。例如，飞行中遭遇积冰会降低飞机性能，堵塞空速管，使驾驶舱空速或高度指示异常；机翼积冰会减少升力、增加阻力，所以我们应尽力避开积冰。

cards.audioText: Besides CB, turbulence, are there any other adverse weather conditions that could affect our flight safety, and if yes, please describe it in detail?
cards.audioTextZh: 除了积雨云（CB）、颠簸，还有其他会影响飞行安全的恶劣天气状况吗？
cards.referenceText: Yes, there are some adverse weather conditions, such as thunderstorms (TS), lightning strikes, icing, wind shear (WS), and so on. They are very dangerous for flight safety. For example, if we encounter WS during flight, it can make the aircraft lose airspeed and altitude quickly. Our aircraft will be difficult to control, even stall or crash. It is very dangerous.
cards.referenceTextZh: 有，存在如雷暴（TS）、雷击、积冰、风切变（WS）等恶劣天气状况，它们对飞行安全极为危险。例如，飞行中遭遇风切变（WS），会使飞机迅速损失空速和高度，飞机将难以操控，甚至失速或坠毁，非常危险。

cards.audioText: Which weather conditions do you think is the most dangerous to flight safety?
cards.audioTextZh: 你认为哪种天气状况对飞行安全最危险？
cards.referenceText: I think wind shear (WS) is the most dangerous to flight safety. Because if we encounter wind shear (WS) during flight, it can make the aircraft lose airspeed and altitude quickly. Our aircraft will be difficult to control, even stall or crash. It is very dangerous.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我认为风切变（WS，wind shear ）对飞行安全最危险。因为若飞行中遭遇风切变（WS ），它会使飞机迅速损失空速和高度，飞机将难以操控，甚至失速或坠毁，非常危险。

cards.audioText: What are your suggestions about reducing risks and incidents caused by dangerous weather?
cards.audioTextZh: 对于降低由危险天气引发的风险和事故，你有哪些建议？
cards.referenceText: This is a sample answer that should be adapted to the speaker’s real experience. Pilots can reduce dangerous-weather risk through thorough preparation, clear crew coordination, and timely use of reliable weather information. During flight, they should monitor changing conditions, use available detection equipment, and request deviations or level changes before the margin becomes small. Delaying, going around, or diverting is appropriate whenever a safe operation cannot be assured.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这是一个应根据答题者真实经历调整的示范回答。飞行员可以通过充分准备、清楚的机组协同和及时使用可靠天气信息来降低危险天气风险。飞行中应监控天气变化，使用可用探测设备，并在安全裕度变小前申请绕飞或改变高度。只要无法确保安全运行，就应考虑延误、复飞或备降。

cards.audioText: How do you know the weather information before departure?
cards.audioTextZh: 起飞前,你如何获取天气信息？
cards.referenceText: Before departure, I obtain weather information from multiple sources: NOTAM, ATIS broadcasts, ATC briefings, METAR reports, and pilot reports (PIREP). I also check weather data for the departure airport, en-route, and destination airport through the dispatching office to ensure comprehensive preparation.
cards.referenceTextZh: 起飞前，我通过多种渠道获取天气信息：航行通告（NOTAM）、自动终端情报服务（ATIS）广播、空管简报、机场天气报告（METAR）以及飞行员报告（PIREP）。同时通过签派部门查询起降机场、航路及目的地机场的天气数据，确保准备全面。

cards.audioText: Based on your experience, can you tell me what weather do you think is the worst or the most dangerous?
cards.audioTextZh: 根据你的经验,你觉得最坏的或者最危险的天气是什么？
cards.referenceText: In my opinion, thunderstorms with cumulonimbus clouds (CB) are the most dangerous. They bring multiple hazards: lightning strike, severe turbulence, icing, hail, and wind shear. These can cause structural damage, system failure, loss of control, and even crash, posing comprehensive threats to flight safety.
cards.referenceTextZh: 依我经验，伴随积雨云（CB）的雷暴是最危险的天气。它伴随雷击、强颠簸、积冰、冰雹和风切变等多种风险，可能造成结构损伤、系统失效、飞机失控甚至坠毁，对飞行安全构成全面威胁。

cards.audioText: Have you ever experienced such bad weather in your career?
cards.audioTextZh: 在你的职业生涯中,遭遇这样的坏天气吗？
cards.referenceText: This is a sample answer that should be adapted to the speaker’s real experience. Yes, I encountered a thunderstorm when flying from one airport to another last year. The aircraft faced severe turbulence and lightning flashes. I followed SOP, monitored weather radar, requested deviation from ATC, and maintained stable control. We avoided the core area and landed safely without damage or injuries.
cards.referenceTextZh: 这是一个应根据答题者真实经历调整的示范回答。遇到过。去年从一个机场飞往另一个机场时，我遭遇了雷暴天气，飞机遭遇强颠簸并出现闪电。我遵循标准操作程序，监控气象雷达，向空管申请偏离航线，保持稳定控制，最终避开雷暴核心区域，安全着陆且无人员伤亡和设备损坏。
